name: bridge-get-operation
description: Returns the full bridge operation record for a specific opId (its start is enough when only one record matches): the id a timed-out call names, or one from bridge-get-status maxOperations:N. queueWaitMs = how long Unity took to pick the call up (long: the editor's main thread was busy); durationMs counts from the queue. While Unity still runs a call whose wait timed out, the record says stale; Unity rewrites it when the call ends.

opId.description: Operation id to read (UUID shown in bridge status/operation rows).
